about: A daily all-day series, a day given its own notes and the change undone, the series made timed at 10:00 Los Angeles, then the redo. Since the gate (decisions.md, "An undo acts on a day only where the journal says exactly where it is") the redo is refused as not_undoable, with nothing written here or sent: the day had no row and no skip when the series was re-placed, so nothing recorded where it went, and it is never placed by its key or its date (x-day).
